records.context: The cell level follows brieflow. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``).
